description: api-search provider preset for podcast discovery per entity: Apple Podcasts (iTunes Search API, no auth). Returns each podcast's RSS feedUrl for handoff to the built rss-feeds module (episode enumeration). Pipeline-agnostic: entity-name search, no vertical baked in. YouTube (video/channel search) is intentionally NOT in this preset — see README (blocked on the api-search field_map template form + a YouTube Data API key).
